request.description: One ordinary practical adjustable steel wrench for a cozy industrial salvage game. Broad readable open C-shaped jaw with a visible adjustable jaw/knurled screw, straight slim handle and small hole at handle end. Neutral worn steel gray with near-black outline and 3 restrained silver shades. No orange, gold, colored grip, rust patches, neon, ornate decorations or face. Front of the wrench, vertical with jaw at TOP and handle down. One simple compact tool, approximately 7 pixels wide by 17 pixels tall, centered inside transparent48x64 canvas with ample empty margin, readable native single pixels; not filling the canvas. It will be held by a 50-pixel-tall human character. No hand or body, no ground/shadow.
